svg.aria-label: Three boxes share one NATS hub on hub-box, and only bmesh talks to it. One workflow, end to end: the coordinator starts a lead on every box; task-1's check that needs macOS runs on the laptop and its result comes back; task-2's question reaches the phone; the coordinator holds task-1 until task-3 has landed, then releases it; task-1 lands, then task-2, each reported to the coordinator and the phone, each land moving its own box's checkout, and bmesh sync carries the last to build-box and the laptop
svg.title: buildermesh across boxes

g.text: no NATS here: its bmesh dials
bmesh hub · relays to the hub
